component.name: Familiar
component.summary: Talk to a model running on your own machine

description.p: Familiar is an assistant for GNOME that talks to a llama-server on your own hardware. No account, no API bill, and nothing leaves the machine unless you switch on the web tools and the model reaches for one.
It remembers by writing Markdown into your notes — the same folder Brain uses — so what the assistant knows is a file you can read, edit and delete without either app.
Contexts keep separate work separate, each with its own persona and its own tools.
